thread:
sarah.sales: Heads-up — ACME wants a 90d EU on-prem + VPC evaluation. They9re pushing for the platform fee to be waived for the POC and want 40 support hours included. Need deal desk + security sign-off before I send a formal proposal.

mike_se: Quick technical question — are they asking for KMS/HSM integration or will customer-managed keys inside their VPC be OK?

sarah.sales: They specified customer-managed keys and that the control plane should live in their private VPC. They also attached a short SQ (link: https://acme.co/security-questionnaire).

julia_security: We can accept customer-managed keys, but legal requires a key control addendum that states keys never leave customer infra. SOC2 artifacts available but will take ~72 hours to assemble. Can't approve a full platform-fee waiver without contract protections.

nate_finance: Pricing policy note — we generally don't full-waive platform fees for POCs unless expected ARR >= $100k. Alternatives: credits, time-boxed discounts, or conditional forgiveness tied to a paid commit.

aj.dealdesk: Escalation path: full waiver = VP Revenue approval + Legal signoff on addenda. Suggest this structured offer (rapid to approve):

```
POC Offer (90 days)
- Platform fee: 60% credit applied to invoice for POC months 1-3
- One-time POC credit: $25,000 applied as invoice credit
- Support: 20 onboarding hours + 20 support hours during POC at discounted rate
- Conditional forgiveness: if ACME signs 12mo commitment within 30 days post-POC, remaining 40% platform fee credit auto-applies (netting to full-waiver)
- Requirements: executed key-control addendum, signed SOW, completed SQ
- Approvals: Deal Desk + VP Revenue (for credit) + Legal for addendum
```

mike_se: Engineering estimate for validating KMS + provisioning scripts: ~4 engineer-days. Custom HSM connector would be +7 days and require extra security testing.

julia_security: Addendum detail — need explicit acceptance of our scoping limitations and a security testing window. Also require a short kickoff call with their security engineers before any connector work.

nate_finance: That offer is acceptable if ACME's forecast ARR >= $120k or they sign an initial 12mo commit. If not, reduce the one-time credit by $10k.

sarah.sales: They asked if the POC credit can appear as an invoice credit (preferred) rather than a negative line item. Is that OK?

aj.dealdesk: Invoice credit is fine, but Legal wants specific credit memo language. I'll draft credit memo and SOW language. @julia_security can you provide the key-control addendum language by EOD?

deploy-bot: sf-opportunity-ACME-12345 created by sarah.sales (stage: POC requested)

julia_security: Will put a one-page key-control addendum draft in the opportunity and ping @aj.dealdesk by 17:00. :thumbsup:

aj.dealdesk: I'm pulling in VP Revenue now. If we get verbal OK today I can convert into formal SOW + credit memo and route for e-sign tomorrow.

sarah.sales: Great — sending the draft to ACME now to keep momentum. I'll include the invoice-credit format and note the conditional commit term. Ping me here for any follow-ups or if legal needs more from ACME's procurement team.

mike_se: FYI — if they want the HSM connector we should get their HSM vendor details now so we can budget the extra dev time.

nate_finance: Also note: any onboarding hours beyond the included 40 will be billed at standard T&M rates unless we negotiate a pre-paid block.

aj.dealdesk: Action items: 1) @julia_security: addendum draft by EOD; 2) @aj.dealdesk: draft credit memo + SOW; 3) @sarah.sales: confirm ARR estimate & share HSM vendor if applicable; 4) @mike_se: prep eng estimate doc for SOW.

sarah.sales: Copy that — will follow up with ACME on ARR projection and HSM vendor. Thanks everyone.
